      public InventoryButton(ItemStack itemStack, @Nullable Msg message)
      Parameters:
      itemStack - The ItemStack to render the button as.
      message - The pure function producing a Msg from a ClickInput. This function is expected to be pure, and undefined behaviour may occur if it is not. The function may return null, which is treated as no message, i.e. "do nothing".
